        "On reset (active-high), initialize grant registers to 0, grant_valid to 0, and grant_encoded to 0.",
        "Determine the request_valid signal by OR-reducing the request signal.",
        "Encode the request signal into request_encoded using a priority encoder.",
        "If ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN is set, update round_robin_index based on the last granted port and request signal.",
        "If ARB_BLOCK is set, set block_condition to 1 if a grant is blocked and ARB_BLOCK_ACK is set, acknowledge signal is 0.",
        "If block_condition is 1, hold the grant until block_release is set (acknowledge signal matches the current grant).",
        "Otherwise, update next_grant based on the request_encoded or round_robin_index.",
        "On the rising edge of clk, if reset is active, reset all internal registers.",
        "If reset is inactive and request_valid is 1 and not blocked, update grant_reg, grant_valid_reg, and grant_encoded_reg based on next_grant.",
        "Drive the grant, grant_valid, and grant_encoded ports from grant_reg, grant_valid_reg, and grant_encoded_reg respectively."
      ]
    }
  ]
